tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: Newest White Report articles (headline, summary, dates, URLs). Start here for the newest coverage; use search_articles instead when you have a topic or keyword, and get_article for one article's full text once you have its slug.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the article archive by keyword (headline, summary, key facts, entities, tickers). Use get_latest instead for the newest articles without a query; open a hit's full text with get_article (the slug comes from the search results).

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Full machine-readable article (the JSON twin: facts, sources, call, full text). Use search_articles or get_latest first if you do not have a slug.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Market snapshot: crypto top 5, SI stocks, and metrics, with the snapshot timestamp. For the publication's dated predictions and their grades, use get_scoreboard instead.

tools.name: get_scoreboard
tools.description: Every dated public call The White Report has made, its grade date, and its grade (null while pending). Start here for the track record in human-readable form; use calls_list instead for the sealed machine-format envelopes (wr.calls.v1) behind the same calls.

tools.name: calls_list
tools.description: Machine format (wr.calls.v1, testnet): sealed per-call envelopes from the graded-calls ledger. Optional filters: state (grade_state), asset (substring of asset_or_event). Historical record only. Use calls_get for one call's full envelope once you have its call_id, calls_since to sync only what is ne

tools.name: calls_get
tools.description: Machine format (wr.calls.v1, testnet): the full sealed envelope for one call id (e.g. ep.6). Use calls_list first if you do not have a call_id.

tools.name: calls_since
tools.description: Machine format (wr.calls.v1, testnet): call envelopes with published_at after the given ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (v1 basis: published_at). Use calls_list instead when you need state/asset filters rather than a time window.

tools.name: event_briefs_list
tools.description: Machine format (wr.event.v1, testnet): the scheduled-event coverage calendar and brief index (id, version, event, sla_met). Use event_brief_get for one brief's full sealed envelope once you have its id.

tools.name: event_brief_get
tools.description: Machine format (wr.event.v1, testnet): one sealed event brief envelope by id; version optional (default: latest version). Use event_briefs_list first if you do not have a brief id.

tools.name: telemetry_latest
tools.description: Machine format (wr.telemetry.v1, testnet): the latest sealed compile envelope per telemetry metric; optional metric filter. Use telemetry_series instead for every envelope of one metric over time.

tools.name: telemetry_series
tools.description: Machine format (wr.telemetry.v1, testnet): every sealed compile envelope for one metric id, oldest first. Use telemetry_latest instead when you only need the newest envelope per metric.
